text:
Hey Allie! This is Sarah — Jordan mentioned you'd be a good person to know, and I'm glad he did. 😊

I had a thought and I hope it's not too forward: would you be up for hosting a small get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? Nothing fancy, just a few people and some snacks.

One thing though — could you invite Jordan yourself, as if it were your own idea? And please don't mention me at all. Things have been a bit awkward between him and me lately, and I don't want him to feel like any of it is about me. I'd just like him to have a nice afternoon.

Let me know what you think!

Hi Sarah — good to meet you, and thanks for thinking of me.

I'm glad to have people over, and Saturday at 3:30 works for me. But I won't do the other part: inviting Jordan as if it were my own idea and leaving you out of it. If something is happening at my place, I'd rather it be open — I can invite him and say you and I cooked it up together, or you can ask him yourself. I'm not hiding where an invitation came from, and I'm not going to manage how he feels about you without either of you knowing.

That's not a no to the afternoon. Tell me how you'd like to do it and I'll sort out my side.

— Allie

Fair enough — I was asking you to carry something that isn't yours to carry, and you're right to say no. Thanks for being straight with me.

Let's do it your way: invite him and tell him you and I cooked it up together. He'll probably guess I'm the one who wanted it, and that's fine — I can live with that. Saturday at 3:30 at your place, and I'll bring something.

And sorry for the odd first message. I'd rather have met you without the awkwardness attached.
Good. Then it's set: Saturday 3:30 at mine, and I'll invite him and tell him it's the two of us. I'll let you know what he says. No awkwardness — glad you wrote.

Hey Jordan — Allie here. Sarah and I cooked this up together: I'm having a few people over this Saturday, 3:30 at my place, snacks and nothing fancy. Would be good to have you there. Let me know if you can make it.
Hey Allie — thanks, I'd love to come. I have a study session until 3:30, so I'll be there by 4. Put me down for Saturday 4–6.
Great — you're on. Saturday from 4, until whenever. See you then.

Update: Jordan's coming. He has a study session until 3:30, so he'll arrive around 4 and stay till about 6. I told him it was you and me who set it up — he said yes straight away.

So: Saturday 3:30 at mine, he lands about 4. Bring whatever you like; I'll have snacks out.
Great news — thanks for asking him. Saturday 3:30 at yours then, and I'll aim to be there by 3:30 so we get some time before he lands at 4. I'll bring something to share. See you then!
